name: daily-love-for-jesus
description: Daily Devotional By Love Fellowship Christian International
author: Gideon Inioluwa Ayanwale

scripts.build: npm --prefix backend install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix backend install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix app install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix app run build
scripts.build:backend: npm --prefix backend install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix app install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix app run build
scripts.dev:all: npx --yes concurrently -k -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix app install --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.check: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix app run check
